t: The FloPlast push-fit access bend provides a reliable and efficient solution for soil and vent drainage systems. Manufactured from robust uPVC, this 110mm access bend offers exceptional strength and durability for various plumbing installations. Its lightweight design ensures ease of handling and installation, making it ideal for both new builds and renovation projects by plumbers and drainage specialists. The innovative design includes a single socket and allows for easy testing and essential maintenance of the soil system, ensuring long-term performance. It is also suitable for managing high-temperature waste discharges, providing versatile application. The use of silicone lubricant on all seals will facilitate jointing.
